timeline.description: Safari 录屏显示 ChatGPT 新对话首页，中央列出 Examples、Capabilities 和 Limitations，左侧为会话栏。右下角的画中画里，卡帕西抬手向观众致意，随后面向镜头讲解。

timeline.speaker: Andrej Karpathy
timeline.description: 卡帕西向观众问候，并以大家已经听闻 ChatGPT 作为课程引入。

text_variants.text: Hi everyone. So by now you have probably heard of ChatGPT.

timeline.speaker: Andrej Karpathy
timeline.description: 卡帕西介绍 ChatGPT 在世界和 AI 社区引起的广泛关注，并说明它允许用户通过文本向 AI 布置任务。

text_variants.text: It has taken the world and the AI community by storm, and it is a system that allows you to interact with an AI and give it text-based tasks.

timeline.speaker: Andrej Karpathy
timeline.description: 卡帕西以生成俳句为例，说明可以让 ChatGPT 围绕人们理解 AI、运用 AI 改善世界并促进繁荣这一主题进行创作。

text_variants.text: So for example, we can ask ChatGPT to write us a small haiku about how important it is that people understand AI, and then they can use it to improve the world and make it more prosperous.

timeline.description: 卡帕西在页面底部输入框中填入英文俳句提示词，随后将其提交给 ChatGPT。

timeline.text: Write a small haiku about how important it is that people understand AI, and that they can use it to improve the world and make it more prosperous.
timeline.description: ChatGPT 输入框中显示请求生成 AI 主题俳句的完整英文提示词。

timeline.speaker: Andrej Karpathy
timeline.description: 提交提示词后，卡帕西读出 ChatGPT 生成的第一版三行俳句。

text_variants.text: So when we run this, AI knowledge brings prosperity for all to see, embrace its power.

timeline.description: 提示词出现在对话区，ChatGPT 在下方回答区逐词生成三行俳句；生成结束后出现 Regenerate response 按钮。

timeline.text:
AI knowledge brings
Prosperity for all to see
Embrace its power
timeline.description: ChatGPT 的第一版回答以三行英文俳句显示在对话区，左侧会话随后获得“AI Prosperity Embrace”标题。

timeline.speaker: Andrej Karpathy
timeline.description: 卡帕西肯定这次生成结果，并指出 ChatGPT 从左到右依次产生这些文字，呈现顺序生成过程。

text_variants.text: Okay, not bad. And so you could see that ChatGPT went from left to right and generated all these words sort of sequentially.

timeline.description: 看着生成的“Embrace its power”，卡帕西露出笑容并笑出声，身体稍后仰，显得觉得结果很有趣。

timeline.speaker: Andrej Karpathy
timeline.description: 卡帕西说明自己此前已经提交过完全相同的提示词，而当时得到的回答与当前版本略有不同。

text_variants.text: Now, I asked it already the exact same prompt a little bit earlier, and it generated a slightly different outcome.

timeline.description: 卡帕西点击左侧先前的“AI's Power Prosperity”会话，主区域随即切换为同一提示词此前生成的另一版回答。

timeline.text:
AI's power to grow
Ignorance holds us back, learn
Prosperity waits
timeline.description: 旧会话中显示同一提示词此前生成的另一版三行英文俳句，供两次回答进行对照。

timeline.speaker: Andrej Karpathy
timeline.description: 卡帕西读出此前生成的第二版俳句，展示它与当前回答在用词和内容上的差异。

text_variants.text: AI's power to grow. Ignorance holds us back. Learn. Prosperity waits.

timeline.speaker: Andrej Karpathy
timeline.description: 卡帕西评价两版结果都不错，同时再次强调它们并不相同。

text_variants.text: So pretty good in both cases and slightly different.

timeline.speaker: Andrej Karpathy
timeline.description: 卡帕西由两次不同回答归纳出 ChatGPT 是概率系统，同一提示词可以得到多个回答；随后开始引出更多提示词示例，话段在片段结束时未完。

text_variants.text: So you can see that ChatGPT is a probabilistic system, and for any one prompt, it can give us multiple answers sort of replying to it. Now this is just one example of a prompt people have come up with
